class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Make calls with the Gemini mobile app on Android</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div><p>You can ask the Gemini mobile app, including Gemini as your mobile assistant,&nbsp;to make phone calls for you with the Phone app. With the Phone app, Gemini can use your device’s calling app&nbsp;to call your contacts, businesses, and phone numbers directly.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>An Android phone or tablet.</li>
  <li>An active mobile phone plan for your device.</li>
  <li>The Gemini app, including as your mobile assistant. <a href="/gemini/answer/14554984" rel="noopener">Learn more about the Gemini mobile app</a>.
    <ul>
      <li>The Phone app isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages or the Gemini web app.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><a href="https://myactivity.google.com/devicecontacts?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Save contact info from your signed-in devices</a> on.
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#sync_device_contacts" rel="noopener">Learn how to sync your device contacts to your Google Account</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Phone Android app permission given to the Google app. <a href="#manage_app_permissions" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage Android app permissions</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats.</li>
  <li>Connected Apps are not available while using <a href="/gemini/answer/14579631#ga_powers" rel="noopener">features powered directly by Google Assistant</a>.</li>
  <li>Don’t use the Phone app in Gemini to call emergency services. Instead, use your device’s calling app directly to make an emergency call.</li>
  <li>On Android devices, you can ask Gemini to make calls at any time, even when <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener">Keep Activity</a> is off. If Keep Activity is off, a call request that requires certain other apps or Google services may not work. For example, asking Gemini to “call the nearest pizza place" would require Google Maps, which isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.
    <ul>
      <li>On connected smartwatches, the Phone app isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="turn_on_extension">Connect the Phone app</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> The Phone app in Gemini is designed to work automatically with the Gemini mobile app. You can disconnect the Phone app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044?co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid#turn_on_off_gma" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini</a>.</p>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Ask it to make a call.
    <ul>
      <li>If Gemini doesn’t use the Phone app, add <code>@Phone</code> to your prompt. If the app isn't connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also say 'Hey Google' to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If 'Hey Google' doesn't work, <a href="/gemini/answer/14579631#vm" rel="noopener">check if 'Hey Google' and Voice Match are set up</a>.</div>

<h2 id="call">Make a phone call</h2>

<p>You can ask the Gemini mobile app to make a phone call for you, in a natural and conversational way.</p>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> By default, the Gemini mobile app uses the last app it used to call the same contact. If the Gemini app uses the Phone app, it uses your default phone app on your Android device. <a href="#check_default_app" rel="noopener">Learn how to change your default phone app</a>.</p>
<a class="zippy" id="based_on_conversation" name="based_on_conversation">Call based on your conversation</a>

<div>
  <div><p>Try these example prompts:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Show me some good Thai restaurants nearby.<br>
    <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="After Gemini&#39;s response:" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG"> Summarize the reviews for the second one. <span id="cke_bm_36363S"> </span><br>
    <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="After Gemini&#39;s response:" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG"> Ok, call this restaurant.</li>
  <li><span id="cke_bm_48497S"> </span>Help me negotiate buying a new car over the phone before going to the dealer.<br>
    <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="After Gemini&#39;s response:" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG"> Call [car dealership] in [city].</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="contacts_phone_numbers" name="contacts_phone_numbers">Call your contacts &amp; phone numbers</a>

<div>
  <div><p>Try these example prompts:</p>

<ul>
  <li>I need to talk to [contacts name]. Can you call them?</li>
  <li>Call [contact first name]’s [mobile, home, work] number.</li>
  <li>Call [contact full name].</li>
  <li>Can you call [phone number]?</li>
  <li>Call my voicemail.</li>
</ul>

<p>Gemini can make a call based on a relationship (e.g., “call my sister”) if the relationship is saved in your instructions for Gemini.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="call_business_organization" name="call_business_organization">Call a business or organization</a>

<div>
  <div><p>Try these example prompts:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Call the closest [cuisine] restaurant</li>
  <li>Call [business with multiple locations]<br>
    <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="After Gemini&#39;s response:" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/frvWg2Dxr5NI0rRhwxFP1jLtJCdn6tmafYeu_0htDn8wsl_qtlwV5SqqKi_MP06p6bFG"> The one on [street name]</li>
  <li>Call [business or organization name]</li>
  <li>Call my district representative</li>
  <li>Can you call the nearest hospital</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="settings">Manage settings</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="sync_device_contacts" name="sync_device_contacts">Sync your device contacts to your Google Account</a>

<div>
  <div><ol>
  <li>On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the left, tap Menu<strong>&nbsp;</strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;your <strong>Profile pic</strong> or <strong>Initial</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Contact info from your devices</strong>.</li>
  <li>Turn on <strong>Save contact info from your signed-in devices</strong>.</li>
</ol>

<p><a href="/accounts/answer/6135999" rel="noopener">Learn how to manage contact info from your devices</a>.</p>
</div>

  <div><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://myactivity.google.com/devicecontacts?utm_source=help" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Go to setting</a></div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="manage_app_permissions" name="manage_app_permissions">Manage Android app permissions</a>

<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong> To use the Phone app in the Gemini mobile app, you need to allow the Google app access to your <strong>Phone</strong>.</p>

  <div><ol>
  <li>Touch and hold the Google app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/PEWD_fUjIuuGs6JuN7INKonFxRVkQI1K27a6KTjyY1_O4coZZIF2XkNnIIHW2xxClC8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/PEWD_fUjIuuGs6JuN7INKonFxRVkQI1K27a6KTjyY1_O4coZZIF2XkNnIIHW2xxClC8">.</li>
  <li>Tap <strong>App info</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Permissions</strong>.</li>
  <li>To change a permission setting, tap it, then choose <strong>Allow</strong> or <strong>Don't allow</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <div><p><strong>Tip:</strong> For a better experience, you can also choose to allow access to your:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Call Logs</strong> to help Gemini connect you to the right person</li>
  <li><strong>Contacts</strong> to call device contacts that aren’t synced to your Google Account</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="check_default_app" name="check_default_app">Check or change your default phone app</a>

<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong> Some steps may vary by device and Android version.</p>

  <div><ol>
  <li>On your Android device, open Settings <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9UoF6T0z5irdwevAnIc1hgUk6BclU2QGRMbZ9spX_uglqGx4xde4jJgY3anMaB8UFKs=w36-h36" width="18" height="18" alt="Settings app" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9UoF6T0z5irdwevAnIc1hgUk6BclU2QGRMbZ9spX_uglqGx4xde4jJgY3anMaB8UFKs">.</li>
  <li>Tap <strong>Apps</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Default apps</strong> or <strong>Choose default apps</strong>.</li>
  <li>Tap <strong>Phone app</strong>.</li>
  <li>To change the default app, select the phone app you want to use.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="take_action_phone_locked" name="take_action_phone_locked"> Take action when your phone is locked</a>

<div>
  <div><p>To control whether Gemini can help you with answers to general questions when your device is locked:</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the left, tap Menu<strong>&nbsp;</strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp; your <strong>Profile picture</strong> or <strong>Initial</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong>.</li>
  <li>Tap <strong>Gemini on lock screen</strong>.</li>
  <li>Turn <strong>Use Gemini without unlocking</strong> on or off.</li>
</ol>

<h4>Allow calls and text messages without unlocking your phone</h4>

<p>You can ask Gemini to make calls and send text messages without unlocking your phone.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the left, tap Menu<strong>&nbsp;</strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;your <strong>Profile picture</strong> or <strong>I</strong><strong>nitial</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong>.</li>
  <li>Tap <b>Gemini on lock screen</b>.</li>
  <li>Turn <strong>Allow calls and messages without unlocking</strong> on or off.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="not_supported">What Gemini can’t do with the Phone app</h2>

<div><p>There are some actions that are available with Google Assistant that currently aren't available with the Phone app. For now, the Phone app can't help you accept or reject calls.</p>

<p>While some actions aren’t supported by the Phone app in Gemini yet, your Gemini mobile app may still perform them with help from Google Assistant, even when apps aren't connected. <a href="/gemini/answer/14579631#GA_in_Gemini" rel="noopener">Learn more about Google Assistant features in your Gemini mobile app</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="about_your_data">About your data &amp; communication apps</h2>

<p>The Gemini mobile app uses your data to help it choose the most helpful app to use and connect you with the right person. <a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#comms_ext" rel="noopener">Learn more about your data and communication apps</a>.</p>

<h2 id="about_ext">How your data is handled</h2>

<div><p>Learn more about <a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#data_exchange" rel="noopener">how your data is handled when Gemini works with Connected Apps</a>.</p>
</div>

<div><ul>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13594961" rel="noopener">Gemini Apps Privacy Hub</a></li>

</ul>
